verdict.rationale: Clara documents an accounts-payable surface: its API can "process invoices" and create vendor payments through `POST /api/v3/accounts-payable/pix`. That is AP in the same platform, but only thinly evidenced and only via the Brazilian Pix rail. The "approvals" mention refers to expense reporting, not bill-approval routing, so it does not transfer. Missing for 10: documented invoice capture/OCR workflow, AP bill-approval routing, ACH/check/wire vendor payment methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire

citations.quote: issue and manage cards, retrieve transactions, handle users, process invoices
before creating a Pix payment (`POST /api/v3/accounts-payable/pix`) — it moves money.
